_doc: Master Character Image Generation Prompt Database for Retail Inferno. Contains standalone portrait prompts, compact scene injection snippets, and negative prompts for consistent asset generation across portraits and background environments.

globalStyleGuide.lighting: Harsh, unyielding 4000K commercial overhead industrial fluorescent tube lighting casting faint double-shadows onto high-gloss linoleum flooring. Neutral commercial suburban department store color grading, realistic 35mm photography, sharp focus, natural skin textures.

henderson.name: Store Manager Henderson
henderson.title: The Polished Politician
keyVisualAnchors: electric-blue blinking Bluetooth earpiece in left ear
crisp royal blue MegaMart corporate polo tucked into razor-creased stone khakis
gleaming white orthopedic New Balance running shoes
heavy aluminum clipboard with color-coded spreadsheets clamped to it
porcelain-white veneer smile that never crinkles eyes
neatly parted gelled silver-ash hair with high receding hairline
henderson.portraitPrompt: Medium close-up portrait of a 46-year-old male American retail store general manager, 6'1" tall with an athletic slender build. He has neatly parted and gelled silver-ash hair with a high receding hairline, a clean-shaven razor-sharp jawline, narrow calculating slate-gray eyes, and a wide, blindingly white porcelain veneer smile that does not reach his eyes. He is wearing a crisp royal blue corporate polo shirt with the top two buttons fastened tight and a small yellow-and-white store spark logo embroidered on the left chest, tucked into razor-creased stone-khaki chinos with a braided brown leather belt. A small, illuminated Bluetooth earpiece blinks electric-blue in his left ear. He is holding a heavy aluminum clipboard clamped with spreadsheets in one hand, smiling with corporate performative cheer directly at the camera. Photorealistic, 35mm lens, harsh 4000K commercial overhead fluorescent store lighting, subtle linoleum reflection background, natural skin pores, high detail.
henderson.sceneInjectionSnippet: 46-year-old male store manager Henderson, slender athletic build, silver-ash parted hair, wide frozen porcelain smile, wearing a royal blue corporate polo tucked into creased stone khakis, white orthopedic New Balance running shoes, an electric-blue blinking Bluetooth earpiece in his left ear, holding a silver aluminum clipboard clamped with spreadsheets.

cheryl.portraitPrompt: Bust portrait of a 52-year-old female human resources manager in a mega-department store, 5'4" tall with a soft maternal round build. She has shoulder-length strawberry-blonde hair styled in a feathered 1990s bob, a soft round face with rosy rouged cheeks, warm brown eyes behind delicate rose-gold wireframe bifocal reading glasses, and a sweet maternal smile. She wears a muted cream silk blouse with a high rounded collar and a soft pastel-pink floral knit cardigan draped gracefully over her shoulders. Around her neck hangs a woven rainbow fabric lanyard with a laminated badge reading 'CHERYL — PEOPLE & CULTURE LEAD' and three silver filing keys on a retractable reel. She holds a heavy cream-colored manila personnel file stamped 'CONFIDENTIAL' in one arm, with a crystal glass bowl of wrapped red-and-white starlight peppermints visible. Realistic commercial photography, 50mm portrait lens, commercial beige office fluorescent lighting, crisp details, natural skin texture.
cheryl.sceneInjectionSnippet: 52-year-old female HR manager Cheryl, soft maternal build, strawberry-blonde feathered bob, rose-gold wireframe glasses, wearing a cream blouse under a pastel-pink floral cardigan draped over shoulders, rainbow fabric company lanyard, holding a cream manila personnel folder stamped CONFIDENTIAL.

clint.portraitPrompt: Waist-up portrait of a 41-year-old male undercover store loss prevention manager, 5'11" tall, broad-shouldered ex-military stocky build. He has a rugged square jaw with a prominent five-o'clock shadow, weathered leathery skin, squinting cold hazel eyes, and a dark brown buzzcut peppered with gray at the temples. He is dressed in civilian loss prevention plainclothes: a plain unbranded black moisture-wicking polo shirt, dark gray tactical cargo pants, and black composite-toe boots. Mirrored dark aviator sunglasses are hooked over the center placket of his collar. A black Motorola radio sits in a leather holster on his duty belt with a clear coiled acoustic earpiece tube running up inside his collar to his right ear. In one hand, he holds a heavy metal carabiner holding forty master brass display keys and electronic fobs. Deadpan expression, arms loosely folded, standing under cold commercial supermarket lighting, 35mm documentary realism, authentic skin pores, sharp focus.
clint.sceneInjectionSnippet: 41-year-old male security manager Clint, stocky broad-shouldered ex-military build, dark brown buzzcut, heavy five-o'clock shadow, wearing a plain unbranded black polo with mirrored sunglasses hooked onto collar, dark gray tactical cargo pants, clear coiled acoustic earpiece tube in right ear, heavy brass key ring on belt.

donna.portraitPrompt: Waist-up portrait of a 58-year-old veteran female retail worker, 5'3" tall with a sturdy, practical build. She has a chin-length layered bob of salt-and-pepper gray hair streaked with bright silver, deep observant laugh lines around perceptive hazel eyes, and tortoiseshell reading glasses perched low on the bridge of her nose. A chewed yellow No. 2 pencil is tucked behind her right ear. She wears a washed-out, faded royal blue MegaMart company vest that is completely covered with over thirty colorful enamel anniversary pins, safety star awards, and faded smiley-face buttons over a comfortable floral-print cotton blouse. In front of her sits a dented, vintage brushed stainless-steel coffee thermos and a rolled-up newspaper with a half-solved crossword puzzle. She has a dry, knowing smirk on her face, observing the room with decades of experience. Realistic photography, 50mm lens, authentic breakroom lighting, subtle linoleum scuffs in background.

marsha.portraitPrompt: Bust portrait of a 38-year-old female retail front-end department manager, 5'6" tall with a gaunt, tense wiry build. She has wide, frantic hazel eyes with deep dark circles of exhaustion, pale skin with flushed red cheeks, and wispy dark brown hair pulled up into a messy, fraying plastic claw-clip bun with stray sweat-damp strands sticking to her temples. She wears a royal blue polyester company vest over a rumpled black long-sleeve cotton tee, with a bright yellow supervisor band around her left bicep. On her right wrist is a bright purple spiral telephone-cord key bracelet holding three brass cash drawer keys. In her left hand, she grips a massive 32-oz pastel pink insulated tumbler filled with diet soda and crushed ice. High-stress expression, mouth slightly open as if about to page over the radio, front registers and long customer lines blurred in background. Realistic commercial lighting, 35mm lens, sharp authentic details.
